title: Corey McIvor - Whyd you go
style: Acoustic folk rock. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar in D major at 120 BPM. The guitar uses a recurring arpeggiated pattern with open strings, transitioning into rhythmic strumming during the chorus. A male tenor vocal performs with a raw, slightly strained delivery in the higher register. The arrangement is minimalist, featuring only a single acoustic guitar and lead vocals. The vocal melody utilizes long, sustained notes on the word 'away' and 'so', often sliding between pitches. The guitar playing incorporates percussive accents on the body of the instrument during the strummed sections.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar in D major]

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals enter]
Why you went away
I cannot tell you so
You went alone

[Chorus]
[strummed acoustic guitar, higher vocal intensity]
Fly and fly and fly away
You don't know
Why I love you so
Fly and fly and fly away
Fly and fly and fly away
Fly and fly and fly away

[Verse 2]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar returns]
Don't you know
I love you so

[Chorus]
[strummed acoustic guitar]
Fly and fly and fly away
You don't know
Why I love you so
Fly and fly and fly away
Fly and fly and fly away
Fly and fly and fly away
[final sustained guitar chord]
